description: Graph-native proof-carrying self-change reasoning.  Mechanical FaultProbe measurements become ObservedGap -> CausalHypothesis -> ChangeSpec/RulePatch -> ProofObligation -> Trial -> Canary -> Commit|Abort -> Consolidation.  Candidate patches must beat both no-op and same-size placebo controls, preserve invariants, fit a resource budget, and replicate. Gains are integer evidence units; all cognitive quantities are integer. No Python decision.

microtheory.name: self_change_reasoning
microtheory.description: minimal causal self-repair under proof obligations, controls, canarying, rollback and consolidation

rules.name: sc_observe_gap
rules.comment: Convert a mechanical FaultProbe into the explicit beginning of a SelfChange.  The probe contains measurements, never a diagnosis.

rules.name: sc_hypothesise_threshold_adjustment
rules.comment: Minimal candidate family threshold_adjustment.  It is proposed from observed structural/behavioural evidence, not from a supplied answer key.

effects.explanation: Relax or move one threshold while preserving the surrounding guard.

rules.name: sc_hypothesise_guard_strengthening
rules.comment: Minimal candidate family guard_strengthening.  It is proposed from observed structural/behavioural evidence, not from a supplied answer key.

effects.explanation: Add the smallest discriminator that excludes the failing context.

rules.name: sc_hypothesise_relation_addition
rules.comment: Minimal candidate family relation_addition.  It is proposed from observed structural/behavioural evidence, not from a supplied answer key.

effects.explanation: Add one causally supported relation to the match or guard.

rules.name: sc_hypothesise_effect_substitution
rules.comment: Minimal candidate family effect_substitution.  It is proposed from observed structural/behavioural evidence, not from a supplied answer key.

effects.explanation: Substitute one effect while keeping the triggering conditions fixed.

rules.name: sc_hypothesise_firing_budget_guard
rules.comment: Minimal candidate family firing_budget_guard.  It is proposed from observed structural/behavioural evidence, not from a supplied answer key.

effects.explanation: Add an idempotence or epoch guard around repeated no-op firing.

rules.name: sc_mint_proof_obligations
rules.comment: Every patch must carry causal, invariant, two-control, budget, and replication obligations before it can enter a trial.

rules.name: sc_trial_discharge_proofs
rules.comment: A patch passes only when it beats both a no-op and a same-size placebo, preserves protected invariants, stays in budget, and replicates.  These are conjunctions, never an aggregate score.

rules.name: sc_trial_reject_unproven
rules.comment: Negative result is first-class evidence.  A measured patch that fails any preregistered obligation is retained as rejected rather than silently retried.

rules.name: sc_select_minimal_proven_patch
rules.comment: Occam/MDL selection: among patches that independently discharged every obligation, choose the smallest description.  Evidence gates admissibility; MDL only breaks ties inside the admissible set.

rules.name: sc_canary_requests_commit
rules.comment: A canary does not mutate the parent by itself.  Passing canary evidence mints a Commit request carrying the selected RulePatch; the Rust transaction boundary is the mechanical enactor.

rules.name: sc_abort_exhausted_hypotheses
rules.comment: The host may close an evidence batch after mechanically running all arms.  If no patch survived the controls, the graph concludes abort; it never promotes the least-bad failure.

rules.name: sc_abort_refused_transaction
rules.comment: The Rust CAS/validator is authoritative.  A refused RulePatch is turned into explicit graph evidence and never retried unchanged.

rules.name: sc_consolidate_committed_change
rules.comment: A commit becomes retained knowledge only after the enactor reports success and independent post-commit evidence survives restart and cross-context replay.
